title: John Ramirez on human-alien hybrid programs

tellings.quote:
GS15 and he's come out now and I think
on your show as well saying that like
he's sure we have hybrid programs, human

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that John Ramirez, a former US government official at a senior civil service grade called GS-15, has come out publicly saying he is sure there are secret programs creating human-alien hybrids. Michels mentions this alongside Lou Elizondo, a former Pentagon official who has spoken about these topics. If true, it would mean the government is hiding something far stranger than sightings.
